input._script:
using Base64
using JSON3
const B64 = ""
const GROUPS = [["relu_field", "remat_cross", "remat_shapes", "retire_empty", "retire_if", "retire_in_if"]]
work = get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp")
root = joinpath(work, "stade_par", "run_" * string(round(Int, time())))
mkpath(root)
write(joinpath(root, "p.tgz"), base64decode(B64))
run(`tar -xzf $(joinpath(root, "p.tgz")) -C $root`)
td = joinpath(root, "t", "STADE.jl", "test")
t0 = time()
out = Dict{String,Any}()
for (gi, g) in enumerate(GROUPS)
    if time() - t0 > 840
        out["g$gi"] = Dict("skipped" => true, "kernels" => g); continue
    end
    code = "include(\"validate_corpus_gpu.jl\"); validate_corpus_gpu(\"val-corpus\"; only = $(repr(g)), trials = 2,  run_jacc = false, write_generated = false)"
    log = joinpath(root, "g$gi.log")
    t1 = time()
    p = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(Cmd(`timeout $(max(30, round(Int, 860 - (time() - t0)))) julia --startup-file=no -e $code`; dir = td)); stdout = log, stderr = log * ".err"))
    txt = isfile(log) ? read(log, String) : ""
    lines = filter(l -> occursin(r"\[(adjoint|hvp)/", l) || occursin("checks passed", l) || occursin("!!", l), split(txt, "\n"))
    err = isfile(log * ".err") ? read(log * ".err", String) : ""
    out["g$gi"] = Dict("rc" => p.exitcode, "s" => time() - t1, "kernels" => g, "lines" => lines, "err_tail" => err[max(1, end - 600):end])
end
out["host"] = strip(read(`hostname`, String)); out["total_s"] = time() - t0
println(JSON3.write(out))
